2. JsonMetaSchema.getInstance(String) not found. Need to use appropriate method. In library, JsonMetaSchema likely has static getInstance() without args, or maybe getV4(). Let's check typical networknt json-schema library. JsonMetaSchema has static getV4(), getV6(), etc. There is also getInstance(String uri). Not sure. But we can avoid using JsonMetaSchema at all. But the constructor signature includes defaultMetaSchemaURI string, and expects that map contains that key? Not sure. But we can simplify: Use JsonMetaSchema.builder().uri(defaultMetaSchemaURI).build()? Not sure.

Let's inspect JsonMetaSchema class typical in networknt. I recall JsonMetaSchema has static getInstance(String uri) maybe exists. But compilation says not found. So modify setup: remove dummyMetaSchema creation, just create empty map.

Thus expectedUriFactory = new URIFactory() { @Override public URI create(String uri) { return URI.create(uri); } };

But we also need to support baseUri? Not needed.

Similarly URNFactory abstract method create(String). So implement accordingly.

4. In customFactory implementations adjust method signature.

5. Remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) annotation.

6. Remove import of MockitoExtension.

Now adjust code accordingly.

Also need to import URIFactory correctly (already imported). Ensure we have correct import for URNFactory.
